## Summary

I extended the business-day rule in `OwnerRestControllerV1.businessDay(...)` so that public holidays are treated as non-business days, rolling forward to the next non-holiday business day.

Changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` constant holding the fixed list: `2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28`.
- Rewrote `businessDay(...)` to loop-forward one day at a time while the date is a non-business day, replacing the previous fixed Saturday→+2 / Sunday→+1 logic. This correctly handles chains (e.g. a holiday adjacent to a weekend, or `2026-12-25` Friday → skip weekend → `2026-12-28` holiday → `2026-12-29`).
- Added an `isNonBusinessDay(...)` helper that flags Saturdays, Sundays, and listed holidays, plus the `java.util.Set` import.

Because the adjustment happens before deriving the daily-limit bucket and membership-number year segment, all downstream values continue to use the adjusted business day. The existing acceptance test (invariant: default registration date is never a weekend) passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test, 0 failures).
